label: Phase two — seal the east tunnels
location: The desert hall before the hatchery tunnels

recentEvents.value: She decreed the exits and the law in plain words; he heard every one and advanced, so she stopped addressing him and started addressing her tunnels.

unresolvedConflicts.value: He is not deceived. He is decided.

temporaryObjective.value: Seal the east tunnels. Wake the hatchery-mothers. Close from both sides.

notes: 'You understand every word I say, don't you? Seal the east tunnels. Wake the hatchery-mothers.'
